benchmarks.label: Brent

peak.note: Futures intraday wartime high (Wikipedia chronology). Physical Dated Brent (EIA spot via FRED) peaked at $138.21 on 2026-04-07 and was $114.89 on 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.note: Eased to about $110.74 on 21 Oct (Trading Economics), down slightly from Monday's five-month-high close near $111.50 but still up roughly 3.9% w/w, as Houthi claims of fresh strikes on Saudi energy sites and Kpler data showing Middle East oil flows back at pre-war levels pulled the market in opposite directions. Week-ago is this site's 14 Oct reading, exactly 7 days earlier.

note: Brent and WTI eased slightly from Monday's five-month highs as Houthis claimed fresh strikes on Saudi Aramco's Yanbu site and the Shaybah oil field (unverified, no Saudi confirmation) while Kpler data showed total Middle East oil flows, including Hormuz bypass routes, matching pre-war levels. TTF and JKM eased off their 19 Oct 2026 highs; Henry Hub continued easing.
